trajectory.patch:
The linker error `undefined reference to crc8_ccitt` indicates that the CRC library, which provides the `crc8_ccitt` function, is not being included in the build. To resolve this, the `CONFIG_CRC` Kconfig option needs to be enabled.

The Zephyr Memory Storage (ZMS) subsystem uses CRC for data integrity, as evidenced by the use of `crc8_ccitt` in its test suite (`tests/subsys/kvss/zms/src/main.c`). Therefore, the most appropriate fix is to make the ZMS subsystem itself select the CRC library. This ensures that any application or test that uses ZMS will automatically have CRC support enabled.

Previous attempts to modify `prj.conf` or `Kconfig` files within the `tests/` directory were reverted because these files are part of the test specification. Attempts to modify `subsys/kvss/zms/Kconfig` failed due to a `SearchMatchFailed` error, indicating that the `SEARCH` block did not exactly match the file's content.

To address the `SearchMatchFailed` and correctly enable `CONFIG_CRC`, the patch will modify `subsys/kvss/zms/Kconfig` to add `select CRC` to the `config ZMS` entry. The `SEARCH` block is made more robust by only including the `config ZMS`, `bool`, and `depends on` lines, which are less likely to vary than the `help` text.

subsys/kvss/zms/Kconfig
<<<<<<<< SEARCH
config ZMS
	bool "Zephyr Memory Storage"
	depends on FLASH
========
config ZMS
	bool "Zephyr Memory Storage"
	depends on FLASH
	select CRC
>>>>>>>> REPLACE
